run.selection: lowest predicted QUBO score among every feasible observed mask
run.scope: Fresh timed replay. Wall time includes label generation, regression, CPU simulation-based angle optimization, IBM connection/transpilation/submission/queue, decoding and final retraining/test. Common data loading and mask-feature enumeration are outside the timed interval.

hardware.bit_order: Qiskit c15..c0; neuron group i is bit i of int(key,2)

circuit_metadata.estimate_warning: Approximation only; server overhead and runtime behavior can differ. No billing guarantee.

separate_8group_random_comparison.scope: Separate eight-group hardware experiment, expected best-of-32 accuracy inferred from measured counts; invalid quantum shots count toward the proposal budget.

provenance: Copied from the completed saved runs. No new training or hardware execution during packaging.
mode: Recorded IBM hardware; optional live CPU retraining is disabled by default.
